question: Explain why describing Andorra as a coastal Caribbean island would be wrong.

draft.raw: O1|P4.1,P4.2,P4.3,P4.4,P4.5|Andorra|location|Describing Andorra as a coastal Caribbean island would be wrong because Andorra is a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe, bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south. It is not located in the Caribbean Sea or any coastal area associated with it. Additionally, Andorra is the sixth-smallest state in Europe and is not part of the Caribbean islands.

claims.subject: Andorra
claims.text: Describing Andorra as a coastal Caribbean island would be wrong because Andorra is a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe, bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south. It is not located in the Caribbean Sea or any coastal area associated with it. Additionally, Andorra is the sixth-smallest state in Europe and is not part of the Caribbean islands.

references.label: P4.1
references.text: Andorra,[c] officially the Principality of Andorra,[d][15] is a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula, in the eastern Pyrenees in southwestern Europe, bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south.

references.label: P4.2
references.text: Believed to have been created by Charlemagne, Andorra was ruled by the count of Urgell until 988, when it was transferred to the Diocese of Urgell.

references.label: P4.3
references.text: Andorra was formed as a polity by a charter in 1278, being a lordship within the Principality of Catalonia until 1715.

references.label: P4.4
references.text: It is currently headed by two co-princes: the Bishop of Urgell in Catalonia, Spain, and the president of France.

references.label: P4.5
references.text: Its capital and largest city is Andorra la Vella.
